name: breathe
description: A breathing guide while Claude works: box breathing (or an even or calm pattern) as words and a bar above the prompt in the terminal, and an aurora orb that expands and contracts in Claude Desktop. When the turn ends it finishes the breath you are in. It steps aside for Claude's questions, and can say each phase aloud.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: box: breathe in, hold, breathe out, hold. even: breathe in and out, no holds. calm: breathe in, then out for 1.5 times as long, no holds. /breathe box, even or calm picks one for the session.

phaseSeconds.title: Seconds per phase
phaseSeconds.description: Length of each phase. In calm the breath out takes 1.5 times this. 4 is the classic box breathing.

startAfterSeconds.title: Show after (seconds)
startAfterSeconds.description: Wait this long into a turn before the animation (its countdown first) appears, so a quick answer does not call up a breathing exercise. 0 shows it right away.

countdownSeconds.title: Countdown (seconds)
countdownSeconds.description: Count down from this number to 0 before the first breath, one number a second: 3 shows 3, 2, 1, 0. 0 starts breathing at once.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: auto: the orb grows and shrinks, unless your system asks for less motion. reduced: never, two still orbs fade into each other instead.

theme.title: Desktop theme
theme.description: Which theme Claude Desktop is set to, for the color of the word beside the orb. auto is a grey that reads on both, a little dim.

speak.title: Speak the phases
speak.description: Say each phase aloud (Einatmen, Halten, Ausatmen) with the system voice, on the machine where the session runs. macOS only. Off by default.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the labels next to the animation, and of the spoken words.
